anne: Starting prod migration: add index on user_settings(service, key) — kicking off now. Running via deploy-bot. Command:
```
./deploy migrate db -m 2026_03_add_user_settings_index --concurrent
```
Please watch for long locks on users.* tables. If index create blocks >10m, abort and switch to chunked backfill plan.

deploy-bot: deploy started: migration=2026_03_add_user_settings_index env=prod step=apply-index ts=3939999999

sam: seeing lock on users table from analytics_copy process PID 4123. Query: `COPY ...` May be long-lived. Recommend pause copy.

raj: agree — pause analytics job and retry index create CONCURRENTLY. If still blocked, fallback: create a partial index + feature-flag rollout then chunked backfill.

olivia: +1 paused analytics job (ticket #INC-3421). Waiting 30s then retry.

deploy-bot: retry index create step failed: lock_wait 320s -> aborting index create. Rolling back schema DDL (no table changes applied).

anne: Ok switching to fallback. Pin api-service to v2.4.1 (no migrations expected post-backfill). Sam/raj, can you outline chunked backfill SQL? Need minimal locking.

sam: chunked update plan:
```
-- loop by id ranges
UPDATE user_settings
SET settings_json = ...
WHERE id > $start AND id <= $end
LIMIT 5000;
```
Run at ~10 qps, sleep 200ms between batches. Keep transactions small.

raj: Will run for estimated 3h for ~3M rows. Will monitor replication lag and CPU. If lag > 2000ms, pause. Rollout plan: enable feature flag `new-settings-index` after backfill completes.

olivia: creating release notes draft:
- Add index on user_settings (deferred: created after backfill)
- Backfill will touch ~3M rows, run as throttled job
- No API changes; pin API service to v2.4.1 during backfill
- Rollback: feature flag off + stop backfill job

anne: Thanks. Oncall - set up hotspot alerts for replication lag and p99 DB CPU. If any critical alarm fires, we'll stop job and re-evaluate. :alarm_clock: 

infra-oncall: Alerts configured: db.replication_lag.p99 > 1500ms, db.cpu.p99 > 90%. We'll ping #incidents if triggered.

deploy-bot: scheduled backfill job at 04:30 UTC; job_id=bf-20260320-01

raj: starting backfill now (batch size 5k, pause 200ms). Monitoring: https://grafana.redwood/db/replication

olivia: tagging release notes and sending to release channel. :shipit: 

ante: closing thread — keep updates in this thread for any stop/rollback. Thanks team.
